diagnostic_targets: Heavy elongate broad torso with deep ribs and short stout limbs; not slender Hyracodon or high-legged running rhino.
Broad cheek and short facial region with eyes high on the skull; restrained rounded ears and thickened upper lip inferred, no long tapir trunk.
Clearly visible paired enlarged canine tips near mouth front, upper canines downwards, restrained lower canines upwards; no saber-cat fangs or elephant tusks.
Absolutely no nasal/frontal horn. Low smooth head profile with a modest fleshed posterior crest, not a tall horn.
Four functional hoofed toes on EACH forefoot, three on EACH hindfoot; do not inherit Hyracodon three-front-toe count.
Substantial neck, broad rump, tapering tail, restrained gray-brown skin with no armor plating.

scale.status: 555mm premaxilla-occipital measured in 2023 Table3 UNISTRA.2015.0.1106. Fullbody artist estimate from skeletal outline, not same-specimen measurement; avoid presenting 3m as measured.

scientific_limits.en: Whole living reconstruction, not a scan or a single complete measured individual. Skull reference UNISTRA.2015.0.1106 measures 555 mm premaxilla to occipital; MGS1493 greatest skull length 600 mm belongs to a different specimen. AMNH1496 and Osborn mounted skeleton are additional comparisons. Body, ear, lip, tail and skin dimensions are artistic estimates, not fossil soft-tissue measurements. Semiaquatic behavior is a hypothesis; no tapir trunk or rhinoceros horn is justified.
scientific_limits.zh: 完整活体复原，非扫描或同一实测完整个体。UNISTRA.2015.0.1106 前颌至枕部555毫米为实测，MGS1493最大颅长600毫米属另一标本；AMNH1496及Osborn骨架为额外对照。全体、耳、唇、尾与皮肤尺寸为复原估值，非化石软组织实测。半水生为推断，不添加貘鼻或犀角。
